cohort: A 33-year-old woman with symptomatic uterine prolapse who underwent laparoscopic hysterosacropexy and subsequently became pregnant.
finding: Pregnancy could be considered after hysterosacropexy in motivated and well-counselled patients, with a scheduled caesarean section being performed without complication and no sign of prolapse recurrence.
mod_finding: A scheduled caesarean section was performed without complication.
